Which of the following is correct concerning logit and probit models?
Option A: They use a different method of transforming the model so that the probabilities lie between zero and one
Option B: The logit model can result in too many observations falling at exactly zero or exactly one
Option C: For the logit model, the marginal effect of a change in one of the explanatory variables is simply the estimate of the parameter attached to that variable, whereas this is not the case for the probit model
Option D: The probit model is based on a cumulative logistic function
